facts.fact: Google 搜索 Emily Pierce 与室友。
facts.anchor: Emily Pierce Leeds student murdered flatmate
FLATMATE OF MURDERED LEEDS STUDENT PAYS TRIBUTE TO ‘WARM-HEARTED’ FRIEND.

facts.fact: 室友 Alice Wheatley 震惊心碎。
facts.anchor: Alice Wheatley said she was ‘shocked and heartbroken’ by the 19-year-old’s death.

facts.fact: 三室友在市中心夜店，袭击者闯入时 Emily 独自在家。
facts.anchor: Her three flatmates were celebrating the millennium at a city centre nightclub when an attacker broke into their building and found Pierce at home alone.

facts.fact: 锁定在利兹读过书、现居伦敦的 Alice。
facts.anchor: This Alice Wheatley had studied in Leeds and now lived in London.

facts.fact: 学校距 Totnes 十七分钟车程。
facts.anchor: A seventeen-minute drive from Totnes in Devon.

facts.fact: 2010 年报道：嫌疑人被捕后无条件释放。
facts.anchor: A man arrested last week in connection with the 1999 murder of Leeds student Emily Pierce has been released without charge.

facts.fact: 嫌疑人 Jason McIntyre，无固定住所。
facts.anchor: Jason McIntyre, of no fixed abode, was questioned over the unsolved killing of the 19-year-old, carried out as partying students saw in the millennium.
The article was dated 2010 and written by a journalist called Kate Marsden.

facts.fact: Alice 本人在评论区发声。
facts.anchor: The search goes on. My heart goes out to her family.

facts.fact: 从律所网站拿邮箱发信。
facts.anchor: The firm’s website provided Alice’s email address and Olivia didn’t hesitate this time. Didn’t give herself time to consider whether it was wise. She opened her own email, pasted in the address and began to type. Hit send and exhaled.

facts.fact: 收件箱顶部看见 Aiden 回信。
facts.anchor: Then, near the top of her inbox, she spotted Aiden Berkeley’s reply.
